children: Vietnam's finance minister, Ngo Van Tuan, said on Thursday that conditions are currently not suitable for an offshore bond issuance, with issuance costs very high.
But Vietnam has not abandoned its offshore bond plan and will continue engaging with investors, Tuan said, adding that it stood ready to proceed when market conditions become more favourable.
